## Purpose
`/admin/login`: platform admin sign-in, which redirects to the safe `next` path.

## Responsibilities
`AdminLoginPage`:
- the form posts `adminApi.login`;
- on success, refreshes `authApi.session` and navigates to `safeNext(next, "/admin")`;
- titled "Admin sign in — Agentic AI Design Patterns";
- uses the `AuthParts` layout.

## Key elements
`AdminLoginPage`.

## Control flow
A form submit.

## Data, state and side effects
Sets the admin session cookie (server-side).

## Configuration
None.

## Interactions
- **Backend:** `/api/admin/auth/login`.

## Error handling and edge cases
- Errors are shown in the form. Lockout is enforced by the server.

## Nuances and gotchas
- **A bootstrap admin must change their password at first sign-in.**

## How to rebuild this file
As described.

None.
